screens.purpose: Lists the investor's buy/sell orders (Open/All filter), per-order StatusPill, cancels the oldest pending order (or a specific row's order) via PATCH /orders/:id/cancel.
screens.evidence: Canvas 04 Buy and Sell.dc.html, artboard s41 ('Orders hub'): searched 'Orders' as screen title -> found (s41 header 'Orders'). Searched 'Filled so far' -> found inline in s41's order card (a 37%-filled progress bar + '40 of 109 shares'), a richer per-order progress affordance than app's plain StatusPill. Canvas uses a 3-way filter 'Open / Done / Cancelled' vs app's 2-way 'Open / All' segmented control. Canvas includes a 'Place a new order' CTA and a 'What these mean' In-queue-vs-Queued explainer block, neither present in the app. No visible per-row or bottom Cancel action appears anywhere in the s41 markup I read -- the app's real, live Cancel functionality (PATCH /orders/:id/cancel, both per-row and a bottom destructive button) has no drawn counterpart in this artboard.
screens.why: Purpose and general shape match well (same order list, same StatusPill vocabulary), but the drawn artboard omits the Cancel action entirely, which is a real, live, wired feature (order_status_screen.dart's own 2026-08-24 history shows this was previously reported broken/missing and fixed) -- shipping s41 as drawn would silently strand that capability unless a human confirms Cancel belongs somewhere off-canvas (e.g. inside the order-detail push this hub implies but doesn't draw).

screens.evidence: Canvas 04 Buy and Sell.dc.html: searched 'Market buy' -> found in s29m's 'Order type' row, matching the app's own 'Order type: Market' row. Searched 'Buy MTNN' -> found as s43m's header. Structural differences found: s42 is a dedicated 'How to buy' CHOICE screen (buy-now vs name-your-price) that the app has no equivalent of (app always defaults straight to a market order when the market is open); s43m is a shares-ONLY stepper input with no naira/shares toggle and no ₦5,000/₦50,000/₦100,000/Max quick-amount chips (all present in the app's real _AmountSheet); s29m's review adds an expandable 'Estimated commission' row and a 'Best price now' line the app doesn't show; s30 is a dedicated PIN-entry step between review and success that the app's real flow has no equivalent of (the app only has an 'I understand the risks' checkbox, no passcode/PIN gate on order placement).
screens.why: Live, core, revenue-path flow. The redesign introduces a NEW security step (per-order PIN) the current implementation doesn't have anywhere, and reshapes amount entry from toggle+chips to a bare stepper -- both are product/security decisions, not just visual restyling, and need a human call before building against this artboard set.

screens.purpose: LIVE Add Money flow: chooser (bank transfer vs card) -> bank-transfer sheet (dedicated virtual account number, Free fee, copy/share) OR card sheet (Flutterwave hosted checkout link, external browser handoff).
screens.route: UNROUTED -- launched via showAddMoneyFlow(context) from the Wallet screen.

The canvas asserts specific priced fees that contradict the app's real 'Free' bank-transfer fact and introduce an unverified ₦28 card fee -- the same class of 'don't fabricate a business fact' concern this codebase's own comments already flag elsewhere (e.g. the 'Blue Marina' co-branding gap), so a human needs to confirm real fee figures before this copy ships.
